purpose: Superseded or failed evidence kept next to the current receipts of this milestone. Bytes are moved with git mv, never edited: each entry records the pre-hygiene path, SHA-256 and size. Retired entries were removed from the tree after their hash was recorded; their bytes remain reachable in Git history at source_commit. Entries marked living are prose kept next to the receipts; they are verified by presence only.

retained.reason: Snapshot of the M2 full/runtime evidence captured before ADR-059; superseded by the re-run gate on the corrected source (docs/validation/M2/full-gate.json).

retired.superseded_reason: pre-hygiene inventory of receipts that are now listed here; redundant

retired_groups.reason: superseded receipts and failed-attempt logs: the accepted receipt of each milestone accredits the shipped bytes; the diagnosis narratives (README/disposition .md) stay
client-qualification transcripts: each attempt keeps receipt.json and protocol.jsonl, which carry the hashes and outcomes; raw inspector/model stdout, stderr and event streams are forensic detail
